title: Supply Chain Attack on event-stream
technical_mechanism: obfuscated flatmap-stream dep decoded AES payload activating only in Copay wallet build; harvested wallet keys
summary: A malicious package 'event-stream' was discovered in the npm ecosystem. The attack involved compromised maintainer + targeted backdoor. Mechanism: obfuscated flatmap-stream dep decoded AES payload activating only in Copay wallet build; harvested wallet keys
